input.quote: At the written request of Customer, given at least 100 days prior to expiration of the Term of the Agreement, M&I shall continue to provide Customer all Services at the rates set forth in this Agreement, for a maximum period of six (6) months.
input.rationale: Section 11.4 supplies Termination Assistance on expiry or any termination, computed at M&I's then-current rates, so the trigger and pricing elements are satisfied. However, the only stated assistance period (six months of continued Services) is conditioned on a written request given at least 100 days before expiry, so no assistance duration is assured after a mid-term termination, and Sections 17.1/17.5 confirm our ownership and M&I's safeguarding duty without any obligation to return or export Customer Data at exit. That fails the fallback on two material terms (assistance duration and data export). We therefore insert a fallback-level clause guaranteeing at least 90 days of Termination Assistance following any expiry or termination and export of all Customer Data within 30 days, leaving the existing then-current-rate and six-month continuation mechanics untouched.

proposal.summary: Add minimum 90-day post-termination Termination Assistance period and 30-day Customer Data export obligation
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.4 gives us assistance at M&I's then-current rates, but the six-month continuation is only available if we ask 100 days before expiry, and nothing requires M&I to give our data back. We have added a fallback-level 90-day assistance floor on any expiry or termination and a 30-day Customer Data export obligation.

ops.text: Data Return; Minimum Transition Period. Upon the expiration or any termination of this Agreement for any reason, M&I shall provide Termination Assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and shall export and deliver to Customer all Customer Data within thirty (30) days following such expiration or termination.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
mappings.quote: Commencing six (6) months prior to the expiration of the Term of this Agreement, or upon any termination of this Agreement for any reason, M&I shall provide Customer, at Customer's expense, all necessary assistance

mappings.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
